channel.title: StorySplitter AI - Blog & Storyboard Workflow Updates
channel.description: Guides, tutorials, and workflows for splitting AI storyboards, aspect ratio locking, and video generation pipelines with Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and Runway.

item.title: How to Split Midjourney or Stable Diffusion Storyboards in Seconds
item.description: Learn how to edge-crop clustered Midjourney and Stable Diffusion storyboard frames automatically into clean 16:9 panels for video generation tools like Runway Gen-3, Luma Dream Machine, and Pika Labs.

item.title: The Future of AI Filmmaking: Optimizing Your Storyboard Workflow
item.description: Discover pre-visualization optimization strategies for AI cinema: consistent character sheets, zero-server privacy architecture, and session recovery with .storysplitter project archives.

item.title: Aspect Ratios in AI Film: 16:9 vs 9:16 vs Freeform Cropping
item.description: Understanding aspect ratio constraints in AI video synthesis. Why aspect locking is critical to prevent black bar letterboxing and distorted tensor warping in generative video pipelines.
